case_number: Criminal Appeal No. 451 of 2011 and Criminal Appeal No. 1185 of 2011

parties.respondent: The Intelligence Officer, Narcotics Control Bureau

summary: Appeals challenged conviction and sentence under the NDPS Act for possession and trafficking of 5.067 kg heroin. Key issues: admissibility of confessional statements under Section 67 of NDPS Act; validity of seizure and sample drawing by NCB officers; non-examination of independent witnesses; role and status of investigating officer under Section 50. Court held NCB officers are 'police officers' under Evidence Act, rendering confessions inadmissible under Section 25; failure to comply with Section 52A(2) in drawing samples invalidated prosecution evidence; absence of independent witnesses and lack of corroboration required acquittal.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 8(c) read with Sections 21(c), 27A, 28, 29, 30 of NDPS Act
Tofan Singh v. State of Tamil Nadu, (2021) 4 SCC 1
Union of India v. Mohanlal & Anr., (2016) 3 SCC 379
